summary: Frontend-only retest of Feature 2 (role-based header dropdown) after role-key mismatch fix. All 4 sub-scenarios (2A-C broker_individual, 2D property_owner, 2E photographer, 2F visitor) PASSED. Dropdown items match spec, header+dropdown badges show correct Arabic labels, and broker_individual correctly opens AdminDashboard view via role-menu-broker-dashboard.

minor.issue: Returns 403 when accessed by broker_individual after clicking role-menu-broker-dashboard. AdminDashboard view still renders but stats are blank/zero. Either the admin stats endpoint should accept broker_individual role, or a separate broker dashboard endpoint should be created.

test_results_per_scenario.2A-C broker_individual (0533333333): OK – dropdown items: broker-dashboard, my-properties, add-property, contracts, subscription, favorites, notifications, settings, logout. Badge='وسيط عقاري - فرد'. Clicking broker-dashboard opens AdminDashboard view (لوحة التحكم rendered).
test_results_per_scenario.2D property_owner (0544444444): OK – dropdown items: my-properties (primary), add-property, stats, favorites, notifications, settings, logout. No broker-dashboard. Badge='مالك عقار'.
test_results_per_scenario.2E photographer (0566666666): OK – dropdown items: portfolio (primary), shoot-requests, earnings, favorites, notifications, settings, logout. Badge='مصور عقارات'.
test_results_per_scenario.2F visitor (0577777777): OK – dropdown items: favorites, notifications, settings, logout only. No role-specific section. Badge='ضيف'.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Decide whether broker_individual should have access to AdminDashboard stats API. Currently the page opens but stats endpoint returns 403, leaving the cards at 0. Either: (a) restrict broker dashboard view to admin only and create a dedicated broker dashboard for non-admin roles, or (b) extend backend admin-stats endpoint to allow broker_individual/broker_company with scoped data.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/App.js still contains a leftover `individual_broker: null` entry in ROLE_ITEMS (line ~634) alongside the canonical `broker_individual`. Harmless but dead code – can be removed for clarity.
/app/frontend/src/App.js similarly retains `guest: null` alongside `visitor: null` (line ~681). Safe to remove now that USER_TYPES uses `visitor` as the canonical key.
App.js is ~3100 lines – consider splitting Header/RoleMenu/LoginModal into separate component files for maintainability.
test_credentials: OTP via /api/auth/send-otp dev_mode (otp_code in response). Test phones used: 0533333333, 0544444444, 0566666666, 0577777777 (fresh registrations).
seed_data_creation: Created 4 new test users via OTP registration with canonical role keys: broker_individual, property_owner, photographer, visitor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature 2 fully verified after role-key canonicalization. Old test users 0511111111 and 0522222222 from iteration 1 still exist with the OLD role keys (owner/individual_broker) – avoid reusing those phones; use new numbers for any future fresh-registration tests. Map popup (Feature 1) and premium ribbons (Feature 3) were already verified in iteration 1 and skipped per request.
rca of the issue: Iteration 1 RCA: ROLE_ITEMS keyed on `individual_broker`/`company_broker`/`owner`/`guest` while LoginModal was emitting both canonical (`property_owner`, `photographer`) and non-canonical (`owner`, `broker_corporate`) values, and DASHBOARD_ROLES used yet another set. Fix applied: (1) LoginModal sends canonical keys matching USER_TYPES; (2) ROLE_ITEMS keys renamed to broker_individual/broker_company/property_owner/visitor; (3) DASHBOARD_ROLES updated to canonical; (4) userType fallback set to 'visitor'. Verified end-to-end via Playwright – all dropdown items, badges, and dashboard routing now align.
